subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers continue with this external branch as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback candidate after repair, or route the canonical fix through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 after refresh?
rationale: The same bug has overlapping open candidate work, this PR is currently conflicting, and its remaining blockers include proof plus code-review issues that need a canonical-branch choice before merge.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the narrower predicate, action metadata preservation, conflict refresh, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

options.title: Use the member candidate after refresh
options.body: Pause this PR only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 becomes mergeable, proof-accepted or explicitly proof-waived, and covers the same three delivery paths.

options.title: Waive live proof deliberately
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept source/API proof, but the predicate, metadata, and conflict blockers still need repair.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the narrower predicate, action metadata preservation, conflict refresh, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the affected Google Chat API, media, and action code paths.
